rule.data_quality_policy: Baseline and current measurements must be sufficiently comparable under a mission-approved measurement protocol.
follow_up: Review trend and task-specific requirements.
Evaluate VIGILE-AER-001 or VIGILE-AER-002 when applicable.
Clinical assessment if deterioration is unexpected or symptomatic.
rule.purpose: Evaluate preservation of aerobic capacity relative to the individual's pre-mission baseline.
rule.title: In-mission aerobic capacity retention

rule.data_quality_policy: Never aggregate unlike tests into one retention ratio without a separately validated model.
follow_up: Review longitudinal strength trend.
Review exercise-countermeasure adherence and measurement context.
Medical evaluation if accompanied by injury, pain, focal weakness or unexpected deterioration.
rule.purpose: Evaluate in-mission muscle-strength preservation relative to baseline.
rule.title: In-mission skeletal muscle strength retention
